title: Transferring and viewing files in isolation: file types, size limit, Protected Storage and printing

prose.text: Sandbox and Votiro handling of transferred files is in [[zbi.file-scanning]]. A page that lists these limits outside this area is open {{gap:ranges-limits-page}}.

checks.do: Whether the file type is one that can be opened in isolation or only downloaded and uploaded, and whether it is under 1 GB.
Whether an exception rule for URL filtering exists and the profile Security controls allow the transfer.

pdf-conversion-protected-storage.statement: Files rendered in isolation are converted into a PDF in the isolation browser rather than rendered in their original format, and Protected Storage holds certain files temporarily for the duration of the isolation session.

quotes: Files that you render within isolation are not rendered in their original format, but are converted into a PDF in the isolation browser and then rendered for viewing.
The isolation browser provides a secure area called Protected Storage, where certain files are rendered and held temporarily for the duration of the isolation session.

viewable-file-types.statement: Files of these types can be uploaded, downloaded and opened to render and view in isolation: video .mp4, .ogg, .webm, .wav; audio .mp3, .wav, .ogg; documents .pdf, .txt, .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .xlsm, .pptx, .ppt; images .jpg, .png, .gif, .bmp, .svg, .ico, .webp, .apng; compressed .zip, .tar, .7z, .rar; other .json, .xml, .html, .csv, .rtf.

quotes: You can upload and download the following file types to your Protected Storage and your device, and you can open them directly to render and view while in isolation:
Video formats: .mp4, .ogg, . webm, .wav
Audio formats: .mp3, .wav, .ogg
Document formats: .pdf, .txt, .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .xlsm, .pptx, .ppt
Image formats: .jpg, .png, .gif, .bmp, .svg, .ico, .webp, .apng
Compressed formats: .zip, .tar, .7z, .rar
Other formats: .json, .xml, .html, .csv, .rtf

non-viewable-file-types.statement: The .odt, .ods, .odp and .vsdx types can be uploaded and downloaded but not opened for rendering in isolation; video .avi, .mov, .wmv, .avif, .m4v, .m4a, .mkv, .ogv, .oga and image .tiff, .mng, .cur cannot be rendered or viewed but can still be downloaded or uploaded directly.

quotes: You can upload and download .odt, .ods, .odp, and .vsdx file types, but you cannot open them to render and view in isolation.
You cannot render or view the following file types in isolation. However, you can still download or upload them directly to and from your device:
Video formats: .avi, .mov, .wmv, .avif, .m4v, .m4a, .mkv, .ogv, .oga
Image formats: .tiff, .mng, .cur

size-limit-and-counts.statement: The file size limit for uploading and downloading in an isolated session is 1 GB per file; isolation sets no minimum or maximum number of files transferred at once, multiple files can be uploaded simultaneously and downloads are individual.

quotes: The file size limit for uploading and downloading files in an isolated session is 1 GB per file.
You can upload multiple files simultaneously, and download files individually.
Isolation does not set a minimum or maximum limit on how many files you can transfer at once because it depends on each user's personal environment configurations.

password-protected-prompt.statement: A user opening an Office file or password-protected file is prompted for the file-specific password, and the file is then rendered in the isolation browser for the duration of the session.

quotes: If a user accesses an Office file or password-protected file, they are prompted to enter the file-specific password.
Then the file is rendered on the isolation browser for the duration of the isolated session.

zia-url-filtering-exception.statement: To access files from isolation via an Internet & SaaS isolation profile an exception rule for URL filtering must be configured, and the profile Security controls must allow file download, upload or viewing.

quotes: To ensure that you can access files from isolation via an Internet & SaaS isolation profile, you must configure an exception rule for URL filtering.

Before you can begin downloading, uploading, or viewing files within isolation, make sure the Security controls for your Internet & SaaS (ZIA) or Private Access (ZPA) isolation profile are set to allow you to do so.

printing-disabled.statement: When printing is disabled on an isolation profile the user cannot see the print option in the right-click menu or the Print icon in the Zero Trust Mode menu, and File > Print or Ctrl/Cmd+P shows a message that this is disabled by policy.

quotes: When printing is disabled on an isolation profile, the user cannot see the print option from the right-click menu or the Print icon in the Zero Trust Mode menu.
If the user tries to select File > Print from the browser menu, or enter the key command CTRL/CMD+P shortcut, a message appears noting that this ability is disabled by policy.

mobile-popups-and-browsers.statement: On some mobile devices file types such as PDFs require the user to allow pop-ups.

quotes: Depending on the mobile device used, some file types such as PDFs require the user to allow pop-ups on their device.

chrome-firefox-viewing.statement: The article says available file types can be viewed in isolation in both Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox browsers.

quotes: You can view available file types in isolation in both Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox browsers.

ranges-limits-page.title: Whether the Ranges & Limitations page states other values for file size, sessions or mobile
ranges-limits-page.detail: The extraction report notes that the Ranges & Limitations page is cited elsewhere for the 1 GB file limit, 10 sessions, 100 MB persistent data and mobile limits but is not in this area; no claim here reads it.
ranges-limits-page.blocks: confirming the limits against the page that lists them
